rows.name: team_grep
rows.description: Governed search (a5p5 lane): strict pattern search over the realm; effects derived read-time, admission-gated before any backend runs.

rows.name: team_glob
rows.description: Governed filename traversal (a5p5 lane): pattern + target ONLY; admission-gated before any backend runs.

rows.name: team_bash
rows.description: Governed shell (a5p5 lane): opaque command text decided by admission + the confined backend; deny-before-backend.

rows.name: read
rows.description: Read one governed text file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once. Defaults to 2000.

rows.name: write
rows.description: Create or fully replace one governed UTF-8 text file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. Overwrites an existing file only when the target is a regular file.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

content.description: the full UTF-8 content to write (empty string clears the file)

rows.name: edit
rows.description: Perform exact string replacements in one governed file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. old_string must appear verbatim (and uniquely unless replace_all is true); the edit never creates a file.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

old_string.description: the exact text to replace (non-empty, must appear verbatim)

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match (default false)

rows.name: read_image
rows.description: Read one governed image file inside this member's admitted file root and attach it to the conversation. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. The file is durably committed to the session's attachment store and referenced as an image block.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it
